card.name: Partway through dose and solution terms
card.fires_on: Partway through a word or number just before a dose amount or solution detail, such as the 'least' in 'at least', 'onic' in isotonic, 'olarity' in osmolarity, the last 0 of 1:1000, or a space before a strength.

modes.label: Inside solution words
modes.description: Middle or end of words like isotonic and osmolarity in infusion instructions.
modes.example: Prochlorperazine edisylate injection may be administered either undiluted or diluted in isot<<onic>> solution.

modes.label: Before a dose amount
modes.description: A number or space or 'least' right before a mg amount or ratio.

modes.label: Inside other long words
modes.description: Partway through technical words such as radiolabeling.

card.plain: It fires partway through a word or number that is about to be followed by a dose or concentration.
